title: Website reliability and profile privacy
content:
Character creation

  • Reliable race and class help. Help opens through the configured website API, including when the frontend and API use different addresses. Missing or unavailable help keeps a clear message.
  • Contained help formatting. Help headings display as text and MUD colors, so stored heading markup cannot change the rest of the page.

Battle previews

  • Keep shared battle text intact. Battle link previews preserve literal room-name characters, including dollar sequences, without inserting page fragments into the preview metadata.

Character pages

  • Follow a character. Player names in battles, guild rosters, leaderboards and statistics open a character page with frag statistics, battle history and forum activity available to you.
  • Keep the right record visible. Switching characters or history pages keeps the requested character and page visible. Links to current characters match their identity, and faction labels distinguish Undead and Neutral.

Profile privacy

  • Private character rosters. Public frag summaries and character links no longer reveal the owning account. Reverse account lookups and account roster lookups have been removed. Forum posts and battle comments retain the account and character you choose to publish.
  • Bounded searches and history. Mention autocomplete limits repeated searches, profile history uses bounded pages, and the leaderboard can filter all four factions.

API failures

  • Clear error messages. Unexpected server failures use a fixed message and support reference while validation and other intended client messages remain available. Internal diagnostics are kept out of responses.
